clusters.label: Broad SAP Developer Tutorial Collection
clusters.rationale: This cluster spans the full breadth of SAP development topics—BTP, HANA, CAP, Fiori, IoT, ML, integration, and more—representing a comprehensive, general-purpose SAP developer learning library rather than a single focused theme.

clusters.label: SAP HANA Cloud Data Management
clusters.rationale: All tutorials revolve around deploying, connecting, querying, modeling, migrating, and managing data within the SAP HANA Cloud ecosystem and its related tools and services.

clusters.label: SAP BTP ABAP Environment Development
clusters.rationale: The tutorials collectively cover the full spectrum of developing, deploying, and managing applications on SAP BTP ABAP Environment, including RAP business objects, Fiori elements, CDS views, authorizations, SaaS extensions, and integrations with S/4HANA and other SAP services.

clusters.label: SAP BTP Full-Stack App Development
clusters.rationale: All tutorials collectively cover the end-to-end spectrum of building, deploying, and managing full-stack applications on SAP BTP, spanning UI development, backend services, cloud runtimes, chatbots, multitenancy, and DevOps tooling.

clusters.rationale: All tutorials revolve around building, automating, and integrating solutions across the SAP Build suite—including Apps, Process Automation, Work Zone, and Code—on SAP BTP.
